privacy.s1_body: The controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is {op_name}, {op_street}, {op_zipcity}, {op_country}, email: {op_email}, phone: {op_phone}. This policy describes how your data is collected, used and protected when you use the Website. We have not appointed a data protection officer as this is not legally required.
privacy.s2_body:
We collect: data provided at registration (name, email address, password in encrypted form, country, optionally phone number and city, account type); data about your listings (texts, photos, price, location) and your messages with other users; data about your use such as favourites, saved searches, reviews, reports and blocks; technical connection data (IP address, time, pages visited, browser and device type) in server logs; verification data (email or SMS confirmation code) and, if you voluntarily request an identity check, a photo of your ID document and a selfie. These images are used only for manual review and are deleted after the decision.

When you open the Website, our server determines your country from your IP address in order to preselect listings and language; the IP address is neither stored for this purpose nor passed on to third parties.
privacy.s3_body: Your data is used to: create and manage your account; publish and moderate your listings; enable messaging between users; ensure platform security and prevent fraud; send you notifications related to your activity (offers, messages, listing status); and improve our services.
privacy.s4_body:
Legal bases are: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract — providing your account and the platform features); Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent — e.g. push notifications, optional cookies, identity check); Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest — security, prevention of abuse and fraud, automated pre-screening of listings, server logs); Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR (legal obligations, e.g. tax-law retention). Information is stored on your device (e.g. login session, language setting) under § 25(2) TDDDG where strictly necessary, and otherwise only with your consent under § 25(1) TDDDG.

Listings are automatically pre-screened for suspicious content; a human decides on suspicious listings. No decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal effects is made.
privacy.s5_body: Your data is not sold. We use the following service providers as processors: IONOS SE (hosting, Germany); Cloudinary (storage and delivery of photos — when photos load, your IP address is transmitted to Cloudinary); Resend (sending emails, USA); for SMS verification Twilio (USA); Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection at registration and listing creation, USA — scripts from Cloudflare are loaded when these forms are opened); for automated pre-screening of listing texts, where applicable, the OpenAI moderation interface (USA); for push notifications the push services of your browser or operating system (Google, Mozilla, Apple). When you open the map view, map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap (OpenStreetMap Foundation, United Kingdom), which transmits your IP address to that service. We deliver fonts ourselves. Other users see the information of your profile and listings that is displayed publicly; authorities receive data only where legally required.
privacy.s6_body: Your data is kept for as long as your account remains active, then deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period after its deletion, unless a longer legal retention obligation applies (in particular for accounting purposes or in the event of an ongoing dispute).
privacy.s7_body:
You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and to object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21). You may withdraw any consent at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR).

You can exercise these rights via your account settings or by email to {op_email}. To protect your data we may verify your identity first.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The authority responsible for us is the Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information, Gustav-Stresemann-Ring 1, 65189 Wiesbaden, Germany.
privacy.s8_body:
The Website uses two categories of cookies:

Essential cookies: required for the Website to function (keeping you logged in, remembering your language and your browsing country). These cookies are always active; without them, certain features of the Website cannot be used.

Audience-measurement cookies: help us understand how the Website is used, so we can improve it. These cookies are only set with your consent, collected via the banner shown on your first visit.

SouqMar24 does not currently use any advertising or social-media cookies.

You can configure your browser at any time to refuse some or all cookies, which may limit certain features of the Website.
privacy.s9_body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures (password encryption, secure HTTPS connections, access control) to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or disclosure.
privacy.s10_body:
Our servers are located in the European Union. Some of the service providers named above (e.g. Resend, Twilio, Cloudflare, Cloudinary, OpenAI) are based in third countries, in particular the USA, or process data there. The transfer relies on an adequacy decision of the European Commission (e.g. the EU-US Data Privacy Framework) or on standard contractual clauses under Art. 46 GDPR.

The service is offered to users worldwide. We treat the data of all users according to the standards of the GDPR, regardless of where they live.
privacy.s11_body: This privacy policy may be updated at any time. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. We invite you to review it regularly.

withdrawal.s1_body: The right of withdrawal described below applies exclusively to paid services subscribed directly with SouqMar24 (featured placement options, premium listings). It does not apply to transactions of goods or services concluded between users through the Website, as SouqMar24 is not a party to such transactions.
withdrawal.s2_body: Under the statutory rules (§§ 312g, 355 German Civil Code) you, as a consumer, have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The period starts on the day the contract is concluded, i.e. when you book the paid service from SouqMar24.
withdrawal.s3_title: Exceptions to the right of withdrawal
withdrawal.s3_body: The right of withdrawal expires for service contracts once we have fully performed the service, provided we began only after your express consent and your confirmation that you lose your right of withdrawal upon full performance (§ 356(4) German Civil Code). If, at your express request, we begin performing before the period has ended (e.g. immediate highlighting of a listing), you must pay reasonable compensation for the service provided up to that point if you withdraw (§ 357a German Civil Code).
withdrawal.s4_body: To exercise your right of withdrawal you must inform us ({op_name}, {op_street}, {op_zipcity}, {op_country}, email: {op_email}, phone: {op_phone}) by means of a clear statement (e.g. by post or email) of your decision to withdraw from the contract, stating the service concerned and the booking date. It is sufficient to send the notice before the withdrawal period has expired.
withdrawal.s5_body: If you validly withdraw from the contract, we will reimburse all payments received from you without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day we receive your withdrawal statement, using the same means of payment you used for the booking, unless agreed otherwise.
withdrawal.s6_body: If you have questions about your right of withdrawal, you can reach us at {op_email}.

about.s1_body: “Souq” (سوق) is the Arabic word for market. In the old towns of the Arab world, souks have for centuries been much more than places to shop: people meet there, exchange news, haggle over prices and often seal a deal with a handshake. Anyone who has walked the alleys of a souk knows the feeling: every stall has a face, every item a story.
about.s2_title: From the souk to the internet
about.s2_body: SouqMar24 carries this idea into the digital age. What is the conversation at the stall in a souk is the chat with us. Haggling becomes the price offer. And the trust that grows there from eye contact and a good reputation is built here by verified profiles and reviews. The marketplace stays local and personal – only now it fits in your pocket and is open around the clock.
about.s3_title: What this can mean for people
about.s3_body:
A marketplace often changes more than a bank balance:

Things get a second life: what sits in your closet is exactly what someone else is looking for – it saves money and conserves resources.

Small income, big impact: whether you are an individual or a small business, one ad reaches the people in your neighbourhood.

Closeness instead of anonymity: buyers and sellers from the same city meet, talk and help each other.

Opportunities nearby: homes, jobs, ride-shares – much of what makes everyday life easier can be found right around you.
about.s4_body:
SouqMar24 is an online marketplace for classified ads: individuals and businesses buy, sell, rent out or give away goods and services here – from vehicles and real estate to electronics, fashion, jobs and ride-sharing. SouqMar24 is open to users in many countries.

Simple: an ad takes just a few minutes to create.

Local: you see offers from your own country and city, and on the map if you like.

Safe: ads are checked automatically, users can verify their profile, and reviews and reports help spot fraud quickly.

Multilingual: the website is available in 11 languages.
about.s5_body: Questions, suggestions or found a bug? You can reach us directly through the contact page – we appreciate every piece of feedback.

how.s1_body: Sign up with your email address and choose whether you act as an individual or as a business. The country you list in is set when you register.
how.s2_body: Choose a category and subcategory, describe your item, set the price, enter the location and upload photos. New ads are checked automatically; our team reviews flagged ads before they go live.
how.s3_body: Buyers browse categories, filter by price, location and features, or search on the map. In the chat you can ask questions and make price offers. With saved searches and by following sellers, you never miss a new ad.
how.s4_body: Agree on the handover and only pay once you have checked the item. After the sale, mark your ad as sold; you can then review each other.

safety.s1_body: Meet at a busy public place for the handover and bring someone along if possible. Inspect the item thoroughly on the spot before paying.
safety.s2_body: Do not send money before you have seen the item. Be especially careful with advance payments, money transfer services, gift card codes and requests for a “deposit to reserve”.
safety.s3_body: Unusually low prices, time pressure, supposed couriers or escrow services and messages with links to outside websites are typical signs of fraud.
safety.s4_body: Never share passwords, bank details or confirmation codes with other users. Prefer the platform’s chat: your phone number stays private there unless you share it yourself.
safety.s5_body: You can report suspicious ads and users – our team reviews every report. You can block unwanted contacts in the chat. Profiles with a verified email address, phone number or ID are marked with a badge.
